thread:
elaine: Heads-up — Aerospan wants a performance POC tomorrow 14:00 PST. Req summary: generative completions, avg ~200 tokens/request (80 in / 120 out), steady 500 RPS, repeated microbursts up to 2k RPS for 60s, 95th latency SLO <= 300ms. Need run plan, cost ballpark, and any enterprise/security blockers (they require KMS + VPC). Can we own run and share results with AE?

vijay: Quick clarifying q: tokens vs requests — you gave tokens/request, good. Using streaming? model variant pinned? and is fallback to smaller model acceptable on overload?

elaine: Yes streaming allowed. They prefer Redwood-verified Llama-2-13b-quant (q4f16) if performance OK. Fallback to 7b is acceptable for spikes but customer prefers fidelity first. Please include cost delta for hosted vs Dedicated.

jordan: Proposed run plan (high level):
- baseline ramp: 0 -> 500 RPS over 5m, hold 10m
- microburst phase: 3x [2k RPS for 60s, 5m cool-down]
- collect: p50/p95/p99 latency (app + token), errors, GPU util, KV cache hits, tail token throughput, network latency distribution
- infra: run on Dedicated test pool (2x A100 style), and mirror with hosted route pinned to q4f16 for parity
- obs: enable token-level traces and per-request profiling, capture model-serving queue lengths

Test command I used (local harness):
```
heyload --model llama-2-13b-q4f16 --qps 2000 --duration 60s --payload-file payload.json --streaming --concurrency 200
```
(we seed requests with avg 200 tokens)

elaine: Aerospan also sent a security note: must confirm KMS integration and whether logs contain PII. Any blockers for a hosted POC with VPC peering?

vijay: KMS + VPC peering is doable for Dedicated and Private, hosted can be VPC-peered with restricted routes but we'll need a short security attestation. Logs: we can redact inputs or route audit logs to customer's KMS. I'll draft answers for their SecQ tomorrow.

elaine: Pricing ask — can you give quick run cost estimate so AE can signal to the prospect? Keep it scrubbed.

vijay: Ballpark cost for the full run (baseline + 3 bursts):
- tokens calc: baseline = 500 RPS * 200 tokens * 600s = 60,000,000 tokens
- bursts = 3 * (2000 RPS * 200 tokens * 60s) = 72,000,000 tokens
- total ~132,000,000 tokens (~132k k-tokens)
- hosted estimate @ $0.006 / 1k tokens -> ~ $792
- Dedicated: depends on committed pool; POC run can be covered under trial credits or a short reserved window — ops/team to confirm additional infra OPEX if we spin up dedicated nodes for the test

jordan: Quick status update after running both runs (just finished):
- hosted (pinned q4f16): p50=110ms, p95=360ms, p99=610ms during microburst, errors ~0.6% (timeouts at peak), KV cache hit ~14%
- dedicated pool (equivalent hw + tuned batch): p50=95ms, p95=280ms, p99=480ms, errors ~0.15%, KV cache hit ~18%
- notes: host route saw queueing spikes when burst ramped too fast; batching parameters and pre-warmed token cache on Dedicated reduced p95 by ~80ms

jordan: Raw anomaly snippets from the run: "95th latency jumps aligned with model queue length > 120". Recommendation:
- increase model parallelism / pre-warm to reduce cold kv cache impact
- enable slightly higher minibatch limits for steady baseline, but lower max-batch for spikes (adaptive batching)
- add a spike fallback policy: route bursts to 7b variant (degrade fidelity) or short-circuit to a cached completion for very frequent prompts

sean: For the SecQ: confirm we can support customer-managed KMS, VPC peering, and log routing. I'll attach compliance checklist to the deal doc. No red flags for POC but for production they'll want Private deployment.

elaine: This is great — can you assemble a 1-page run summary + perf graphs for AE to send to Aerospan? Also please include the cost calc and recommended config (recommended: Dedicated test run + spike-fallback to 7b; if they prefer hosted, suggest throttling policy + shorter TTL caching).

jordan: Will do. I'll put a short write-up in the deal doc and export sample traces. TL;DR for AE to copy: "Baseline stable at 500 RPS with p95 < 300ms on Dedicated; microbursts to 2k RPS need either Dedicated pre-warm + adaptive batching or a 7b fallback to meet 95th SLO consistently. Estimated run cost ~ $800 (hosted) — Dedicated cost depends on commit; discuss with AE." :thumbsup:

sre-bot: benchmark-run completed: job-id=br-2026-03-21-09, artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-pocs/aerospan/4077654321 — perf-summary.csv, traces.json, gpu-metrics.tar.gz

elaine: Perfect. AE will review and loop in Aerospan security for the SecQ answers. Thanks team — please copy the perf-summary.csv into the deal workspace and mark this POC run as "ready for customer review". :rocket:
